item.description:
Beta build, made from code 45401ddf.

  • More connections go direct on networks with IPv6. When this Mac connects to a Windows PC and both networks have IPv6, the connection can now go direct over IPv6 instead of through the relay. This is ready ahead of the next Windows release.
  • Steadier direct connections on Wi-Fi. When your Wi-Fi signal changes, Divergence no longer starts its direct connection over.

Beta build, made from code 955ead51.

  • Back online faster after sleep. When a Mac running this version wakes, your other devices see it online again within a few seconds.
  • A cleaner quit. Quitting Divergence now closes its connection cleanly before the app exits.
  • Smoother audio from a Windows PC. When a Windows PC's sound stops and starts again, the audio on this Mac now picks up smoothly, with no extra delay. This is ready ahead of the next Windows release.

Beta build, made from code b4a6e5d9.

  • See when a Mac is asleep. A Mac running this version tells your other devices when it goes to sleep: its tile reads "Asleep" until it wakes.
  • Know when your input is paused. When a password field on the Mac you're controlling turns on Secure Input, Divergence now tells you that your typing and clicks are paused, and why.
  • A signed-out Mac stays on its own network. A Mac signed out of Divergence can only be reached from its own network, and its Settings say so. Sign back in and its pairings are still there.
